context: Senator's Office. Laura at her desk.

nodes.text: Good morning, Senator John! Your 10 AM is confirmed, and I have the briefing materials Maria prepared.

moodVariations.Relaxed: Good morning! Everything's ready for you!
moodVariations.Neutral: Good morning, Senator. Your 10 AM is confirmed.

publicOptions.text: Thanks. Let me see the schedule.

privateThoughts.text: She's young, earnest. Should I shield her from the harder parts of this job?

nodes.text: You've got debate prep at 11, then lunch with the education committee at 1. Oh, and Maria wanted you to review these talking points before the debate.

moodVariations.Stressed: Debate prep at 11, lunch at 1. Maria wants you to review these.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Debate at 11, lunch at 1! Maria left these talking points.
moodVariations.Neutral: You have debate prep at 11, lunch at 1. Maria left talking points.

publicOptions.text: Perfect. You always keep me organized.
You know, you're far more than just my assistant.

nodes.text: Of course, Senator. I'll be at my desk if you need anything.

moodVariations.Stressed: Of course. I'll be at my desk.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Of course! I'm here if you need me.
moodVariations.Neutral: Of course. I'll be at my desk.

delayed.effect: Laura hesitant to approach during crisis

nodes.text: I... uh, thank you, Senator? I just try to do my job well.

moodVariations.Relaxed: Thank you! I try my best.

publicOptions.text: I meant it professionally. You're good at your job.
I did mean it. But we should focus on work.

delayed.effect: Laura's ending reflects discomfort with power dynamic

nodes.text: Senator... I appreciate that, but I think we should keep things professional.

moodVariations.Relaxed: I appreciate that, but let's stay professional.
moodVariations.Neutral: I think we should keep things professional.

delayed.effect: Laura more vulnerable during scandal, risk +5

nodes.text: Great! Let me know if you need anything else before your 10 AM.

moodVariations.Stressed: Let me know if you need anything.
moodVariations.Relaxed: Great! I'm here if you need me!
moodVariations.Neutral: Let me know if you need anything.
